name: Clone app
description: Update provider names declared by the app. Fixes installation conflicts, but can break features in certain apps

name: Change installer source
description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store

name: Override certificate pinning
description: Overrides certificate pinning, allowing to inspect traffic via a proxy

name: Spoof signature
description: Spoofs the package signature of the original APK

name: Disable Play Store updates
description: Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting

name: Hide ads
description: Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads

name: Channel search
description: Adds an option to search inside the channel that is currently open instead of searching all of YouTube

name: Disable continue watching prompt
description: Adds an option to keep autoplay going instead of pausing with a "Continue watching" prompt after a period of inactivity

name: Copy text
description: Adds options to copy the video title and comments by tapping and holding them

name: Copy video link
description: Adds options to display buttons in the video player to copy video links

name: Remove viewer discretion dialog
description: Adds an option to remove the dialog that appears when opening a video that has been age-restricted by accepting it automatically. This does not bypass the age restriction

name: Disable double tap actions
description: Adds an option to disable player double tap gestures

name: Double tap to seek
description: Adds additional double-tap to seek values to the YouTube settings menu

name: Downloads
description: Adds support to download videos with an external downloader app using the in-app download button or a video player action button

name: Disable haptic feedback
description: Adds an option to disable haptic feedback in the player for various actions

name: Loop video
description: Adds an option to loop videos and display loop video button in the video player

name: Picture-in-picture button
description: Adds an option to display a picture-in-picture button in the video player

name: Play all
description: Adds an option to play all the videos from a channel and to display play all button in the video player

name: Reload video
description: Adds an option to display reload video button in the video player

name: Save to Watch later
description: Adds an option to display save to Watch later button in the video player

name: Seekbar
description: Adds options to show old seekbar thumbnails, disable precise seeking when swiping up on the seekbar, slide to seek instead of playing at 2x speed when pressing and holding, tapping the player seekbar to seek, hiding the video player seekbar, enabling seeking in live streams, and expanding the live stream DVR duration

name: Swipe controls
description: Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls

options.title: Custom icon
options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom icon.
            
            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - mipmap-mdpi
- mipmap-hdpi
- mipmap-xhdpi
- mipmap-xxhdpi
- mipmap-xxxhdpi
            
            Each of the folders must contain all of the following files:
            morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png
            
            The image dimensions must be as follows:
            - mipmap-mdpi: 108x108 px
- mipmap-hdpi: 162x162 px
- mipmap-xhdpi: 216x216 px
- mipmap-xxhdpi: 324x324 px
- mipmap-xxxhdpi: 432x432 px

            Optionally, the path contains a 'drawable' folder with a monochrome icon file:
            morphe_adaptive_monochrome_custom.xml

            Optionally, the path contains a notification icon in one of the following formats:
            - XML vector drawable placed in 'drawable':
              morphe_notification_icon_custom.xml
            - PNG raster images placed in the matching 'drawable-<dpi>' folders:
              - drawable-mdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (24x24 px)
- drawable-hdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (36x36 px)
- drawable-xhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (48x48 px)
- drawable-xxhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (72x72 px)
- drawable-xxxhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (96x96 px)

options.title: App icon
options.description:
The app icon to use, including the notification icon.

            'Automatic' uses the custom icon if one is provided, and otherwise 'Black'.
            Select 'Original' to keep the icon of the unpatched app.

            The icon can be changed later in the app settings, but only for the launcher.
            Android Auto, the app list of the system settings and the apk file always show
            the icon chosen here, and a mounted (root) installation can only change it by
            patching again.

name: Custom branding
description: Adds options to change the app icon and app name. For mounted (root) installations the branding is applied while patching, because it cannot be changed from the app settings.

options.title: Custom header logo
options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom header logo.

            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - drawable-hdpi
- drawable-xhdpi
- drawable-xxhdpi
- drawable-xxxhdpi

            Each of the folders must contain the following file(s):
            - morphe_header_custom_light.png
- morphe_header_custom_dark.png

            Required dimensions:
            - drawable-hdpi: 194x72 px
- drawable-xhdpi: 258x96 px
- drawable-xxhdpi: 387x144 px
- drawable-xxxhdpi: 512x192 px

name: Change header
description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app.

name: Hide video action buttons
description: Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes

options.title: Hide Search app shortcut
options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Search when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.

options.title: Hide Subscriptions app shortcut

name: Navigation bar
description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Subscriptions when long pressing the app icon in your launcher

name: Captions
description: Adds an option to disable captions from being automatically enabled or to set caption cookies

name: Disable layout updates

name: Disable auto feed refresh

name: Add to queue
description: Overrides the feed flyout 'Play next in queue' with the Morphe video queue

name: Force system font
description: Adds an option to show the app with the device system font instead of YouTube Sans

name: Change form factor
description: Adds an option to change the UI appearance to a phone, tablet, or automotive device

name: Ambient mode
description: Adds options to bypass power saving restrictions for Ambient mode and disable it entirely or in fullscreen

name: Hide autoplay preview
description: Adds an option to hide the autoplay preview at the end of videos

name: Hide end screen cards
description: Adds an option to hide suggested video cards at the end of videos

name: Hide end screen suggested video
description: Adds an option to hide the suggested video at the end of videos

name: Hide layout components
description: Adds options to hide general layout components

name: Hide info cards
description: Adds an option to hide info cards that creators add in the video player

name: Hide player flyout menu components
description: Adds options to hide menu components that appear when pressing the gear icon in the video player

name: Disable player popup panels
description: Adds an option to disable panels (such as live chat) from opening automatically

name: Hide related video overlay
description: Adds an option to hide the related video overlay shown when swiping up in fullscreen

name: Hide related videos
description: Adds options to hide related videos

name: Disable rolling number animations

name: Settings menu filter
description: Adds an option to hide items on the standard YouTube settings screen by their visible name

options.title: Hide Shorts app shortcut
options.description: Permanently hides the shortcut to open Shorts when long pressing the app icon in your launcher.

options.title: Hide Shorts widget
options.description: Permanently hides the launcher widget Shorts button.

name: Hide Shorts components
description: Permanently hides the launcher widget Shorts button

name: Disable sign in to TV popup
description: Adds options to disable the popups asking to sign into or connect to a TV on the same local network

name: Hide timestamp
description: Adds an option to hide the timestamp in the bottom left of the video player

name: Open channel of live avatar
description: Adds an option to prevent a channel's current live video from opening when tapping its avatar

name: Miniplayer
description: Adds options to change the in-app minimized player. Patching 21.28.206 and lower has more miniplayer types to choose from

name: Override YouTube Music buttons
description: Overrides YouTube Music buttons to open Morphe Music or any compatible third-party client

name: Restore original titles
description: Adds an option to show the original video titles, video descriptions and channel descriptions instead of the auto-translated ones

name: Playback in feeds
description: Adds the 'Playback in feeds' setting of YouTube to the Morphe settings, where it is always available even if YouTube hides it

name: Mute button
description: Adds an option to show a player button that mutes the video audio

name: Disable fullscreen gestures
description: Adds options to selectively disable gestures for entering and exiting fullscreen mode, and to disable pinch-to-zoom

name: Exit fullscreen mode
description: Adds options to automatically exit fullscreen mode when a video reaches the end

name: Force fullscreen landscape
description: Adds an option to rotate the player to landscape when entering fullscreen mode on tablets and other large screen devices

name: Fullscreen video scale
description: Adds options to stretch or zoom videos to fill the screen in fullscreen mode

name: Open videos fullscreen
description: Adds options to automatically open videos in fullscreen portrait or landscape mode

options.title: Custom icons
options.description:
Zip file with icons to use as the 'Custom' icon style.

    Each icon is named after the icon it replaces, such as 'morphe_yt_copy.xml'.
    An icon is a vector drawable (.xml), or a white square PNG image (.png, 96x96 pixels is recommended).
    Icons missing from the file keep the 'Automatic' style.

name: Player icon style
description: Adds an option to change the style of the player button icons.

name: Custom player overlay opacity
description: Adds an option to change the opacity of the video player background when player controls are visible

name: Disable playlist autoplay
description: Adds an option to stop a playlist from automatically advancing to the next video

name: Return YouTube Dislike
description: Adds an option to show the dislike count of videos with Return YouTube Dislike

name: Disable scrolling speed limit
description: Adds an option to remove limits of how fast the home and subscription feed can be scrolled

name: Open system share sheet
description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet

name: Shorts autoplay
description: Adds options to automatically play the next Short

options.title: Custom icons
options.description:
Zip file with icons to use as the 'Custom' icon style.

    Each icon is named after the icon it replaces, such as 'morphe_shorts_heart.xml'.
    An icon is a vector drawable (.xml), or a white square PNG image (.png, 96x96 pixels is recommended).
    Icons missing from the file keep the 'Automatic' style.

name: Shorts icon style
description: Adds an option to change the style of the Shorts action button icons.

name: Disable Shorts resuming on startup
description: Adds an option to disable Shorts from resuming on app startup when Shorts were last being watched

name: Open Shorts in regular player
description: Adds options to open Shorts in the regular video player

name: SponsorBlock
description: Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content

name: Change start page
description: Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage

name: Hide status bar
description: Adds an option to hide the system status bar. Swipe down from the top edge to show it for a moment

options.title: Dark theme color
options.description: Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings.

options.title: Light theme color
options.description: Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings.

name: Theme
description: Can be a hex color (#RRGGBB) or a color resource reference. Setting a color of either theme applies both while patching and removes the in-app theme color settings

name: Bypass image region restrictions
description: Adds an option to use a different host for user avatar and channel images and can fix missing images that are blocked in some countries

name: Wide search bar
description: Adds a wide search bar to the top of the home and subscription feed

name: AI channel filter
description: Adds options to hide videos from channels flagged as AI-generated by the AiSList community list and to report AI channels from the video menu

name: Remove background playback restrictions
description: Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background

name: Enable debugging
description: Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard

name: Check watch history domain name resolution
description: Checks if the device DNS server is preventing user watch history from being saved

name: GmsCore support
description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services

name: Bypass link redirects
description: Adds an option to bypass redirects and open the original link directly

name: Open links externally
description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app browser

name: Media notification controls
description: Adds options to disable the seekbar and previous/next buttons in the media notification and headphone controls

name: PoToken provider
description: Adds option to get PoToken using an external PoToken minter app

name: Sanitize sharing links
description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links

name: Network proxy
description: Adds settings to route supported network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Including this patch may cause connectivity problems on certain devices

name: Disable QUIC protocol
description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol

name: App refresh rate
description: Adds an option to change the app refresh rate

name: Spoof video streams
description: Adds options to spoof the client video streams to fix playback

name: Spoof app version
description: Adds an option to trick the app into thinking you are running an older version

name: Spoof device dimensions
description: Adds an option to spoof the device dimensions which can unlock higher video qualities

name: Channel whitelist
description: Adds options to allow whitelisting specific channels to show ads or override playback speeds

name: Disable DRC audio
description: Adds an option to disable DRC (Dynamic Range Compression) audio

name: Force original audio
description: Adds an option to always use the original audio track

name: Skip silence
description: Adds an option to automatically skip silent pauses in audio playback

name: Playback buffer
description: Adds an option to change the video playback buffer size

name: Disable video codecs
description: Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 codecs

name: Remember live stream playback position
description: Adds an option to remember the playback position of an ongoing live stream and resume from there when reopening that live stream

name: Video quality
description: Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu

name: Playback speed
description: Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player

name: Voice over translation
